subject: Agriculture
title: Hidden Hunger
description: Learn Hidden Hunger in one minute.

hook.text: Two billion people get enough calories but lack essential vitamins and minerals. They're full but malnourished.

buildup.text: Iron, zinc, vitamin A, and iodine deficiency cause anemia, blindness, stunting, and brain damage—especially in children.

discovery.text: A child stunted by malnutrition in the first 1,000 days suffers irreversible cognitive damage for life.

twist.text: Cheap staples fill stomachs but starve bodies. Processed food has replaced diverse diets in the developing world.

climax.text: Fortification—adding nutrients to flour, salt, and oil—reaches billions cheaply. Iodized salt alone prevents 750 million goiters.

punchline.text: Full stomachs, starving bodies. Calories aren't nutrition.

quiz.question: How many people worldwide suffer from hidden hunger—micronutrient deficiency?
